definition: Tumor-cell fraction at or above the UPMC median.
notes: Pipeline positive control. Same as v1. Density/by-type PP recover it because they encode abundance.

definition: CD8 T-cell fraction at or above the UPMC median.
notes: Pipeline positive control. Same as v1.

definition: After residualizing on CD8 fraction: CD8 cells have unusually many CD8 neighbors within 50 um (hotspot vs diffuse).
notes: Cleanest spatial task. Composition ~chance; type-specific K/L recovers it. Pooled K/L does not.

definition: After residualizing on tumor and stroma fractions: tumor cells have unusually many stromal neighbors within 50 um.
notes: Composition at chance. Type-specific PP and density both recover mixing/compartment structure.

definition: After residualizing on immune and tumor fractions: immune cells are concentrated within 50 um of the tumor boundary.
notes: Density 0.93 shares the tumor polygon with the label; prefer type-specific PP 0.83 as independent evidence.

definition: After residualizing on tumor and CD8 fractions: CD8 cells lie outside the tumor polygon more than abundance predicts.
notes: v2 composition 0.62 is borderline. Density 0.93 is polygon leakage. Type-specific PP 0.83 is the fairer recovery.

definition: After residualizing on B and T fractions: cells sit in 50 um neighborhoods jointly enriched for B and T that form connected clusters of size >=5.
notes: Residualization worked (composition ~0.51) but type-specific PP only 0.65. Needs B–T cross-type features and atlas review before promotion.

definition: After residualizing on tumor and T fractions: T cells have many tumor neighbors within 50 um.
notes: v1 composition 0.80; composition shortcut remains. Not refined as a primary v2 task.

definition: After residualizing on tumor and CD8 fractions: CD8 cells have many tumor neighbors within 50 um.
After residualizing on tumor and macrophage fractions: macrophages sit in tumor-rich 50 um neighborhoods.
After residualizing on tumor and granulocyte fractions: granulocytes sit in tumor-rich 50 um neighborhoods.
After residualizing on APC and T fractions: APCs/macrophages have many T-cell neighbors within 50 um.
After residualizing on immune and vessel fractions: immune cells have many vessel neighbors within 50 um.
